Four of the five depend on friction or deflection, for which no evidence route exists here; the fifth removes the freedom geometrically. That difference is a fact about the available evidence, not a reason to prefer one.

unresolved.why_open: The range is the one quantity the requirements supply, and nothing says whether it is spanned by a continuous adjustment, by discrete positions or by a compliant member.
Every retention obligation here is a resistance to a load whose magnitude, reach and moment are all unstated, so no holding arrangement can be shown adequate.
